caveats: Area weighting assumes people are spread evenly inside a census tract.
A tier is a schedule property of the published timetable, not delivered service.
Each date has one route in the 15-min tier, so the change mostly compares the corridors of two routes.
Distance is a straight line of 800 m, not a walking distance.
ACS values are 5-year estimates with margins of error that are not carried through.
equity.method: Residents = sum over census tracts of total population (ACS 5-year B01003_001E) x share of the tract's area inside the union of 800 m straight-line buffers around every stop served on the date by a route in the 15-min tier; area weighting assumes uniform density inside a tract.
